표지에 낚임 문장력없고 이야기는 되는대로 흘러감~~ 설정에 공감을 못하겠음  이 작가꺼는 한번읽으면 다시 들어다보지않는데 왜삿을까 나새끼 ㅋㅋ

This is a gripping fantasy regression story that stands out for its exceptionally fast pacing and a protagonist who immediately weaponizes her future knowledge to dismantle a lifetime of abuse. Hildegarde is a refreshingly decisive lead; after waking up five years in the past, she bypasses the typical "adjustment period" to instantly purge her household of corrupt relatives and disloyal staff, even using the very poison meant for her to trap her antagonistic cousin. The narrative expertly balances high-stakes political maneuvering with psychological depth, particularly through the villainous Maximilian, whose use of "holy power" to create a literal addiction in Hildegarde adds a layer of dark complexity to her quest for independence. By introducing strong supporting players like the revolutionary strategist Louis Carmel early on, the story expands beyond a simple revenge plot into a fascinating study of reclamation and strategic leadership. With its sharp dialogue, satisfying "karma" moments… like the iconic scene of sprinkling salt to ward off the Prince’s messengers, and the looming mystery of the devoted but dangerous male lead Winter, this webnovel offers a powerful and cathartic journey of a woman fiercely taking back her life.
